Hero.title: Jet Ski and Motorboat Rental.
Hero.subtitle: Discover the beauty of the Great Masurian Lakes with Jet Ski Rental Maciej Skwarko. Book your jet ski or motorboat today!

About.title: About Us
About.description: The attractive location of our region on the Great Masurian Lakes Trail and our passion for water sports inspired the creation of Jet Ski Rental Maciej Skwarko, where you can rent jet skis and motorboats. Visit us during the summer season in Giżycko and spend an exciting time on the water. Discover the wonderful corners of Masuria, inaccessible from land. You will find us in the ports: Stanica Wodna Stranda and Łabędzi Ostrów.

HowItWorks.subtitle: How to rent?
HowItWorks.description: Rent a jet ski or boat online or by phone and enjoy a journey through the land of the Great Masurian Lakes!
